statement: The pinned xpadneo driver repairs selected malformed or variant Bluetooth HID descriptors, including Linux-mode axis usages and an over-wide button declaration, and rewrites compatible input events for Guide, View and Share. Therefore identical raw report bytes need not yield identical evdev behavior under hid-microsoft, hid-generic and xpadneo.
